title: Avoid chains of Effects that set state

slides.say: A card game where one Effect sets state, which triggers another Effect, which sets more state.
Each set call causes a render before the next Effect runs. In the worst case, three unnecessary re-renders of the whole tree below.

slides.text: Also fragile: replaying a past move would re-trigger the whole chain.
slides.say: It is also fragile. If you add game history and set a past card, the chain fires again and changes your data.

slides.text: Fix: calculate what you can in render; set all next state in the event handler.
slides.say: The fix: calculate what you can during render, like is game over, and set all the next state in the event handler, in one go.
